overview: The Council approved committee reports regarding fire stations and Community Preservation Act funding, and heard neighborhood concerns regarding traffic congestion linked to Route 16. The body also processed meeting records and scheduled a year-end tax classification hearing.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved Committee of the Whole reports from November 9, 10, and 16, which included discussions on fire stations and Community Preservation Act (CPA) matters.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Resident Maryanne Adduci reported that neighborhood residents reject proposed traffic designs for the Cotting Street area, arguing that the designs fail to address the root cause of congestion stemming from Route 16.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved meeting records from November 9 and tabled the records for the November 16 and November 23 meetings.

items.title: Announcements and Adjournment
items.summary: Announced an upcoming holiday event and scheduled a Committee of the Whole meeting for a tax classification hearing on December 14.
